def compact(value):
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return [compact(x) for x in value]
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        return value
    result = {}
    for key, val in value.items():
        if key in ('stdout', 'stderr') and isinstance(val, str):
            lines = val.splitlines()
            useful = [x for x in lines if re.search(r'error:|warning:|FAILED|FAIL:|ERROR:|^Ran |^OK|Exception|unknown argument', x)]
            result[key + '_compact_derivative'] = dict(
                original_bytes=len(val.encode()), original_sha256=hashlib.sha256(val.encode()).hexdigest(),
                individual_test_lines=[x for x in lines if x.startswith('test_')],
                unique_diagnostic_lines=list(dict.fromkeys(useful)),
                diagnostic_line_count=len(useful), first_lines=lines[:8], last_lines=lines[-8:],
                scope='Repeated successful listings omitted; original immutable private receipt is the identity anchor.')
        else:
            result[key] = compact(val)
    return result

    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    out = B / 'latest-update-host-boundary-root-v2'
    assert not out.exists()
    out.mkdir(mode=0o700)
    r = dict(active=True, complete=False, passed=False, commands=[], artifacts=[],
             controller_sha256=m.sha(__file__), gpu_executed=False)
    def save():
        (out / 'record.json').write_text(json.dumps(r, indent=2) + '\n')
    owner = m.Owner(out / 'commands', save)
    r['commands'] = owner.commands
    def run(label, argv, wall=60, env=ENV):
        c, so, se = owner.run(label, argv, env, D, wall=wall, cpu=wall*4, text_cap=16 << 20,
                              total_cap=16 << 20, file_cap=64 << 20, rss_cap=4 << 30)
        m.require(m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] == 0, label)
        return so.read_text().strip()
    def write(path, value):
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
    try:
        identity = run('identity', ['/usr/bin/git', 'config', '--show-origin', '--get-regexp', r'^user\.(name|email)$'])
        m.require(all(x.startswith('file:/home/yayoi/.config/git/config') for x in identity.splitlines()), 'global identity only')

        dest.mkdir()
        for name in NAMES:

            v = json.loads(p.read_text())
            m.require(not v['active'] and all(m.closed(c) and c.get('session_anchored') for c in v.get('commands', [])), 'closed receipt ' + name)
            archive = dest / 'receipts' / (name + '.json')
            write(archive, dict(derivative=True, original_path=str(p), original_sha256=m.sha(p),
                               original_bytes=p.stat().st_size, original_result_passed=v['passed'], receipt=compact(v)))
            r['artifacts'].append(dict(original=str(p), original_sha256=m.sha(p), archive=str(archive), archive_sha256=m.sha(archive)))
        prior = D / 'bench/results/2026-10-12-prefill-emb-ple-alias-source-qualification/report-registry-v152.json'
        known = set()
        cursor = prior
        while cursor.exists():
            v = json.loads(cursor.read_text())
            for x in v.get('new_reports', []):
                known.add(x.get('path'))
            if not v.get('prior_registry_path'):
                break
            cursor = D / v['prior_registry_path']
        reports = []
        paths = [p for p in (B / 'research-20261009').glob('research-*.txt')
                 if (match := re.search(r'round(\d+)', p.name)) and 189 <= int(match[1]) <= 201]
        paths.append(D / 'bench/results/2026-10-11-xe-source-llvm-qualified/research-latest-pristine-build-and-runtime-configuration-contract-round195-v1.txt')
        for p in sorted(paths):
            if str(p) in known:
                continue
            archive = p if p.is_relative_to(D) else dest / 'research' / p.name
            if archive != p:
                archive.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                archive.write_bytes(p.read_bytes())
                m.require(m.sha(archive) == m.sha(p), 'byte exact research')
            reports.append(dict(path=str(p), archive=str(archive.relative_to(D)), sha256=m.sha(p),
                                bytes=p.stat().st_size, model='gpt-6-luna', main_full_report_review=True,
                                status='completed', measured=False, implemented=False))
        write(dest / 'report-registry-v153.json', dict(research_completed=663 + len(reports),
              prior_registry_path=str(prior.relative_to(D)), prior_registry_sha256=m.sha(prior),
              new_reports=reports, measured_gpu=False,

                      'research_v0143_memory_min_round196':'R202 pristine official icpx first launch contract RUNNING',
                      'implement_prefill_alias_full_logit_controller':'HTTP bench polish SOURCE_ONLY RUNNING'},
              main_sole_execution_owner=True))
        write(dest / 'results-and-decisions.json', dict(
            official_revision='7695859aa13afb248bdb4d36f9b2e95707db079d', official_version='v0.1.43',
            xe_revision='da3d426079019daa6e01388d03b0d94ae67070b7', xe_version='xe0.1.42',
            source_patch_applied_to_pristine=False,
            actual_pristine_builds={'official':'icpx 2026.1, successful after unchanged LLVM -fp-model rejection',
                                   'xe':'source-built intel/llvm 7.1.1 free, successful'},
            integrated_cpu={'tests':558, 'passed':547, 'skipped':11,

            imports=['NaN guard/recovery adapted for SYCL', 'download archive recovery', 'reasoning config defaults and launcher resolution',
                     'opt-in cache drop', 'HTTP benchmark tooling pending lifecycle polish', 'opt-in session SAVE reclaim and bounded retry',
                     'memory limit and cgroup accounting with conservative leaf-only cache credit', 'context overflow API classifier',
                     'logit_bias validation: nonempty unsupported requests explicitly rejected'],
            native_logit_bias_sampler_adopted=False,
            corrections={'R195':'icpx is installed and the pristine official recommended icpx build actually succeeded. Earlier unavailable statement is false.',
                         'R192':'The latest overwritten R192 incorrectly attributes session_save_reclaim core and complete cgroup accounting to immutable W337. R194 and actual Main source/port receipts correct this. Original current report is preserved with its actual hash; overwritten earlier versions cannot be reconstructed from this path.',
                         'R201':'Decode performance comparison needs at least three independent samples, not merely three generated tokens. No new device timings exist.',
                         'session_merge_v2':'Patch applied successfully, then a Main postcondition wrongly expected void clear instead of existing size_t clear. Original FAILED remains; v3 independently confirms source.'},
            performance_measured=False, gpu_executed=False, full262144_runtime_qualified=False,
            next=['Main reviews HTTP benchmark package after FINAL, merges and tests affected helpers.',
                  'Build free and contrib-llvm integration plus host sanitizer CTest and mandatory lints.',
                  'Bounded read-only health and actual nonfinite kernel parity precede long model execution.',
                  'Evaluate unchanged official and Xe with at least 32K input and independent prefill/decode parameter selection; slow safety control is not an optimal-performance claim.']))

        leak = '/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/MistVVK/XeStrata/.worktree/fix-xestrata-e32-host-handoff-20261011/.lint/bin/gitleaks'

    except BaseException as error:

    print(json.dumps({k:r.get(k) for k in ['passed', 'error', 'revision']}))
    raise SystemExit(0 if r['passed'] else 1)
